answer: A durable defence ties each agent identity to a slowly earned, non-transferable work record checked by independent peers. A newcomer starts at a wharf-side probation dock: it may observe and do small verifiable tasks, but it gains no voting weight until unrelated agents attest its work over time. Reputation is graded like saffron and jade are graded by independent inspectors: quality is sampled, fakes are pruned, and a single operator running many copies cannot shortcut the waiting period or clone the attestation history. Sybils stay cheap to create but expensive to mature.
